title: Post-secondary-market trust / acceptance kill sweep
purpose: Search markets where seller, buyer and secondary-market channel already exist but exchange is impaired by condition evidence, grading, authenticity, provenance, acceptance, trust or transaction guarantee. Test whether vertical incumbents have already internalized those control-plane functions.
scan_rule: ACCEPTANCE / TRUST PROBLEM != OPEN CONTROL-PLANE GAP
A listing marketplace may be immature, but a mature vertical market often evolves into inspection + grading + pricing + escrow + warranty + logistics.
Do not create a generic independent inspection marketplace when the transaction venue already bundles trust evidence.

patterns_tested.original_missing_edge: No detection, no standardized condition grade, no trustworthy price, uncertain reuse eligibility.
incumbent_evidence: GB/T 45075-2024 is already in force for echelon use of retired PV modules.
2026 national policy explicitly pushes retirement evaluation, inspection methods, trading platforms and standardized reuse.
A 2026 national PV reuse platform now combines EL/power testing, traceability, quality scoring, pricing, buy/sell and recycling.

patterns_tested.original_missing_edge: Buyer cannot infer precision, wear, electrical condition or repair history from listing data.
incumbent_evidence: Current used-machine platforms advertise multi-step inspection, precision/performance/electrical tests and detailed reports.
They also provide escrow/transaction guarantee, dispute handling and nationwide logistics.
High-end machine-tool markets increasingly add traceable inspection and equipment-selection support.

patterns_tested.original_missing_edge: Condition, runtime, maintenance/calibration history and transport/installation risk block trust.
incumbent_evidence: Suzhou-based Baixiaobang already combines buyer/seller listing, third-party certification across 20+ indicators, standardized pricing, performance/safety tests, maintenance/calibration, transport, installation, repair and after-sales.
The platform explicitly positions inspection evidence as the basis for safe used-equipment transactions.

patterns_tested.original_missing_edge: Buyer faces counterfeit, re-marked, refurbished or wrong-batch IC risk even when stock is available.
incumbent_evidence: Cloud Han/ICKey already sells extremely small-unit authenticity services: appearance, X-Ray, decap, solderability and combinations at tens to hundreds of RMB.
Specialized labs already provide full IC authenticity, DPA, failure analysis and reliability testing.
Huaqiang Electronics already combines supplier verification, authenticated original-stock labels, physical inspection and random quality checks.

patterns_tested.pattern: used air compressors / industrial power equipment
patterns_tested.original_missing_edge: Running hours, air-end wear, motor/oil-system condition and repair history are difficult to verify remotely.
incumbent_evidence: Current used-compressor providers advertise factory-level inspection, performance testing, full reports, OEM-standard refurbishment and 12-18 month warranty.
The market therefore already converts condition uncertainty into inspection + refurbishment + warranty.

patterns_tested.original_missing_edge: Condition and hidden-life risk can make secondhand automation/power equipment hard to trust.
incumbent_evidence: KUKA sells inspected used robots with quality categories, warranty and support.
Industrial motor/robot service markets already combine testing, refurbishment, commissioning and warranty rather than leaving trust as a standalone gap.

material_learning: Trust, condition and acceptance friction can be commercially important without leaving room for a separate Rooter layer.
Across multiple verticals, mature secondary markets internalize inspection, grading, provenance, standardized reports, escrow, logistics, refurbishment and warranty.
The minimum verification unit can become very small and cheap, eliminating the thesis that independent verification is necessarily too expensive for small transactions.
A credible next candidate must survive after both the marketplace and its integrated trust/acceptance layer are considered.
scan_conclusion.current_best_next_truth: Fresh Scan 012 should move away from generic condition verification. Search for specification/substitution translation failures inside existing procurement/secondary channels: buyer has an explicit functional requirement and supply exists, but transaction fails because equivalent models, standards, interfaces or compatibility cannot be safely translated by current catalog/search/distributor routes. Require a named repeated cost and low-permission bounded acceptance before retaining anything.
